annotations.title: EVM Proxy Slot & Bytecode Selector Disassembler (Free)

description: Disassemble deployed EVM bytecode on Base or Ethereum to resolve EIP-1967/1822/1167 proxies and extract decoded 4-byte PUSH4 function selectors without an Etherscan key. Use this for arbitrary smart contracts (vaults, routers, pools) to inspect proxy admin/implementation slots and SELFDESTRUCT/DELEGATECALL opcodes (100 free calls/day/IP). Returns isProxy, proxyType, implementationAddress, decodedFunctions, and dangerousSelectorsFound. Do NOT use for token market liquidity/honeypot tax audits (use nullclear_scan_token).

address.description: 0x-prefixed 42-char EVM smart contract address on Base or Ethereum

chain.description: Target EVM chain ('base' for Base Mainnet 8453 or 'eth' for Ethereum Mainnet 1)

name: nullclear_inspect_contract
